# DeleteNetPlayer <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Multiplayer](BlitzBasic-Multiplayer)

</div>


```blitzbasic
DeleteNetPlayer:Void player:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | In | Int32 | required | A player made with [CreateNetPlayer](CreateNetPlayer). |

## Description

Removes a player of this program from the game. The others see a message of type 101.
